birth.stop: Massachusetts, the country he names as his own
birth.date_confidence: Birth year unresolved, four candidates. Death notices giving his age as 72 point to 1735, and the Massachusetts Historical Society renders his dates 1735-1807. A letter of Rev. Jeremy Belknap, 1795, gives a range, 1737 or 1738; the Prince Hall Grand Lodge of Massachusetts adopted 1738 from it. A deposition of 31 August 1807 records his age as 'about 70 years', pointing to c. 1737. Grimshaw says 1748. The field carries 1735 and settles nothing. The coordinate is the centroid of Massachusetts, not of New England; Hall's own word is the wider one. This stop precedes the Bridgetown stop because 1735 is the earliest of the four candidate years, not because the atlas prefers it.

stops.stop: London, the Duke of Cumberland signs the warrant
